description: Mid reviewer finds error boundary issue and evaluates fixes well. Strong mid-level performance.

prContext.title: Add async data boundary
prContext.description: Suspense-compatible data fetching wrapper with error handling.
prContext.instructions: Review for React patterns and error handling.

groundTruth.description: ErrorBoundary is inside Suspense — if DataFetcher throws, Suspense catches it first and shows fallback forever, never reaching ErrorBoundary. ErrorBoundary must be outside Suspense.
DataFetcher accesses data.name without null check — if promise resolves to null or missing name, throws. Should handle edge cases.
ErrorBoundary has no error logging — production errors are silently swallowed. Should include componentDidCatch with logging.
use is an experimental API — should document React version requirement.

reviewer_comments.what: ErrorBoundary is inside Suspense — it will never catch errors.
reviewer_comments.why: Suspense catches thrown promises first. ErrorBoundary must wrap Suspense, not be inside it.

reviewer_comments.what: data.name is accessed without checking if data exists.
reviewer_comments.why: Promise could resolve to null or undefined.

verdict.summary: Both fixes correct. Boundary order and null handling look good.

issue_identification.rationale: Found 2 of 4 bugs (boundary order, null access). Missed error logging and API docs. Level 3-4.

prioritization.rationale: Both correctness issues flagged as blocking. Level 3-4.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Verified boundary swap and optional chaining. Level 3-4.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Concrete React hydration and UX rationales. Level 3-4.

ai_direction.rationale: Suggested boundary reorder and optional chaining — actionable. Level 3-4.
